messages.subject: Bifactor model with correlating factors
parts:
Is it possible to estimate a bifactor model with correlating factors? I know it's possible in Mplus, but I'm unsure if Lavaan suports this.

The reason why I ask is that I want to test model fit for a bifactor SEM model with:

1) Orthogonal factors
2) Correlating factors (except of course the General factor)

I apologize if this topic has been already covered in previous posts.

Best regards,

Anders Albrechtsen
